name: Epuja Spiritech Limited
about: Epuja Spiritech Limited operates as a faith-tech platform company in India. It offers ePuja and Havans services, including digital astrology consultations, sale of authenticated rudraksha, gemstones and other spiritual products, pandit at home services for religious ceremonies, and curated spiritual tourism, as well as a range of puja kits, yantras, incense, and related devotional accessories. The company was formerly known as Sagar Productions Limited and changed its name to Epuja Spiritech Limited in December 2023. Epuja Spiritech Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.
